cohort: The participants were women who gave birth in 24 private health facilities in Addis Ababa.
finding: The magnitude of Cesarean section (CS) delivery in private health facilities in Addis Ababa was 57.3%.
mod_finding: The magnitude of CS delivery was 57.3%, with higher rates among women aged 25-29, primiparous women, and those with gestational ages of 37-42 weeks.
gest_age: Gestational ages were measured, with 84% of CS deliveries occurring at 37-42 weeks.
